description: This Java class defines a custom layout manager called BetterFlowLayout that extends FlowLayout to calculate preferred and minimum layout sizes more accurately based on component sizes and container insets.

classes.name: BetterFlowLayout
classes.description: A custom Java layout manager extending FlowLayout, providing improved preferred and minimum size calculations for container layouts.

methods.name: BetterFlowLayout
methods.description: Default constructor, initializes a BetterFlowLayout with default parameters.

methods.name: BetterFlowLayout
methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying alignment, hgap, and vgap for layout.

methods.name: preferredLayoutSize
methods.description: Overrides FlowLayout to return a more accurate preferred size of the container.

methods.name: minimumLayoutSize
methods.description: Overrides FlowLayout to return a more accurate minimum size of the container.

methods.name: betterPreferredSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns a preferred size based on visible components, container insets, and gaps.
